newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 17.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 17.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 92.71 points to 6,679.87, rebounding for the third session in a row.

* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index ended a choppy session up 1.11 points to 1,087.78. Analysts say the market should stay under pressure from concerns about new lending limits and cash calls on leveraged players.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5125/35 a dollar at around 0900 GMT on Wednesday.

* The Dow's overnight gain should provide a positive backdrop for Kuala Lumpur shares, said Patrick Zecha, head of research at South Johor Securities. But, he added, "any strong rebound will be kept back by the fact there still will be spillover selling and fears have not subsided completely."
* Closed-end fund company Seacorp-Schroder SmallCap Fund Bhd is scheduled to list today, with 500 million shares offered at 1.00 ringgit a share.
* The $5.5 billion Bakun dam's holding company, Bakun Hydro-Electric Corp, will sign a shareholders' agreement today. The Bakun initial public offering is expected to list in June.
